claim: NVIDIA announced JetPack 4 EOL on 2024-11-22, the same day it released the final JetPack 4.6.6 (r32.7.6); after EOL users 'will no longer receive any critical updates'; covers Jetson Nano, TX2, TX1; beyond 4.6.6 NVIDIA refers to partners TimeSys and Codethink.
NVIDIA's Jetson lifecycle page lists Jetson Nano available through January 2027 and Xavier NX / AGX Xavier / TX2 NX through July 2027, after the r32 final release (Nov 2024) for Nano and TX2 NX.
Canonical's Ubuntu Pro ESM for JetPack 4 devices covers the Ubuntu 18.04 userspace to 2028 but 'The JetPack 4 kernel (based on the Linux kernel 4.9) remains outside of the scope of the service.'
Jetson Linux archive shows r34 lasted Apr-May 2022 (34.1, 34.1.1) and r38 lasted Aug 2025-Jan 2026 (38.2, 38.2.1, 38.4) before r39 (Jun 2026).
NVIDIA March 2026 Jetson/IGX bulletin (rev 1.0, 2026-03-31): CVE-2026-24148 (8.3), -24154 (7.6), -24153 (5.2) fixed only at branch head: 35.6.4, 36.5, 38.4; r32 not listed.

ONEKEY advisory (2026-09-03) reports a bypass of the CVE-2026-24153 fix affecting Jetson Linux 39.2.0, 38.4.0, 38.2.x, 36.5.0, 35.6.4; fixed in 39.2.1, 36.5.2, 35.6.5; no confirmed 38.x fix at publication; reported to NVIDIA 2026-05-20.
kernel.org longterm kernels are 6.18, 6.12 (EOL Dec 2028), 6.6, 6.1 (Dec 2027), 5.15, 5.10 (Dec 2026); 6.8 (the Jetson Linux r38/r39 kernel) is not longterm.

Canonical (2023-10-18) states that under JetPack kernel security updates were previously unavailable and commits to regression testing and CVE-patching periodic kernel updates with 'long-term support (LTS) and security patching on Ubuntu 22.04' for Jetson Orin, with no stated number of years.
NVIDIA's Jetson AGX Thor FAQ states 'The low-level software stack is unified to dGPU driver(openrm)' and the release check reports KERNEL_VARIANT: oot.
